title: Canary accuracy drift after quantize rollout — incident review & action plan
creator: Maya Patel
description: During a canary rollout of the new int8 quantized model variant for customer-facing text-generation routes, automated quality gates detected a statistically significant accuracy drift on the internal canary suite. The drift did not manifest as a crash, but as a measurable drop in BLEU/ROUGE-like signal and higher hallucination rate on evaluation prompts. We rolled back the quantized variant and initiated an investigation. This ticket captures the timeline, root cause analysis, mitigations, and action items to prevent recurrence.
timeline: 2026-03-09 09:12 UTC: Canary job 7 (us-west) started rolling out runtime-1.23 with int8 quantized variant qv1.2
2026-03-09 10:03 UTC: Canary quality job flagged regression: average semantic-f1 dropped 8% vs baseline (p<0.01)
2026-03-09 10:15 UTC: Alert routed to SRE/ML Infra channel; automated rollback policy triggered; qv1.2 rolled back to float32 variant
2026-03-09 10:22 UTC: Post-rollback canary re-evaluation passed; traffic stabilized
2026-03-09 13:40 UTC: Initial triage meeting; hypothesis generation and owner assignments
2026-03-10 11:00 UTC: Reproduced drift locally on sampled prompts when running int8 kernels with current scale tables
2026-03-11 16:50 UTC: Additional unit tests and inference traces collected; partial fix prototyped (per-channel calibration improvement)
2026-03-14 09:30 UTC: This ticket updated with action items and validation plan
root_cause: Primary cause: Suboptimal per-channel scale factors produced during the offline calibration pass for qv1.2, leading to systematic bias on particular attention heads for the LLaMa-style family we serve

Secondary cause: A change in kernel rounding behavior introduced in runtime-1.23 (micro-optimization for small-tile matmul) interacted with the int8 accumulator path, amplifying the bias in certain token distributions
Contributing factor: Canary evaluation suite sampling did not include a targeted set of prompts that reveal the token-distribution sensitivity introduced by this model family change
Process gap: No pre-rollout numeric distribution drift threshold in the canary gating for quantized variants; gating relied primarily on throughput/latency and coarse metrics
detection: Automated canary evaluation: semantic-f1 and hallucination-rate alerted after statistical check
SRE paged on quality regression, not availability
Engineers repro'd locally using the exact offline calibration artifacts and observed consistent metric drop
immediate_mitigation: Automated rollback executed by canary controller to float32 variant (completed at 10:15 UTC)
Disabled qv1.2 rollout in the staging/dedicated pipelines pending investigation
Added temporary alert rule to catch >3% semantic-f1 regression within 30 minutes for future canaries
postmortem_action_items: ENG-9401-A: Add per-channel calibration verification step to offline quantization pipeline (owner: Priya Kaur, due: 2026-03-18)
ENG-9401-B: Revert the small-tile matmul micro-optimization on int8 path until tests pass across reproduced distributions (owner: Rafael Gomez, due: 2026-03-16)
ENG-9401-C: Expand canary prompt set with targeted distribution-sensitive cases supplied by Applied ML (owner: Anya Li, due: 2026-03-20)
ENG-9401-D: Implement a numeric-drift gate for quantized variants (semantic-f1 delta threshold + bootstrap p-value) in canary controller (owner: Liam O'Connor, due: 2026-03-21)
ENG-9401-E: Build regression unit tests that compare quantized vs float baseline on representative attention-head activations (owner: Devon Park, due: 2026-03-24)
ENG-9401-F: Create rollout runbook update to enforce offline calibration re-run after any kernel-level micro-optimization (owner: SRE Team, due: 2026-03-19)
ENG-9401-G: Post-deployment monitoring: add per-route token-level delta histograms to Console (owner: Observability team, due: 2026-03-30)
ENG-9401-H: Run a backfill scan of previous quantized variants for similar drift signatures in the last 90 days (owner: Maya Patel, due: 2026-03-25)
ENG-9401-I: Add an engineering checklist item: run stochastic calibration with multiple random seeds before creating qv artifacts (owner: Priya Kaur, due: 2026-03-18)
ENG-9401-J: Schedule a retro with Research/Applied ML on quantization calibration methodology (owner: Product, due: 2026-03-22)
validation_and_tests: Unit tests that compare attention head outputs (L2 and sign-aware metrics) between quantized and float runs for 500 representative sequences
A/B synthetic stress harness that runs 10k sampled prompts with different token distributions and reports semantic-f1, perplexity delta, and hallucination count
Calibration stability test: rerun calibration 5 times with different seeds and ensure per-channel scale variance < 2%
Integrate the numeric-drift gate into pre-rollout checks and record a green run before canary push
rollout_and_gating_changes: Add numeric-drift gate to canary controller (see action ENG-9401-D)
Require explicit SRE+AppliedML approval for any kernel micro-optimization that touches int8 paths
Introduce a slow-roll phase for quantized variants: start with 1 canary host, evaluate 4 hourly checkpoints before expanding
Automate rollback on sustained semantic-f1 regression > 2% for 3 consecutive checkpoints
